item.title: When AI Becomes a Product Capability: Start with the Scenario, Not the Model
item.description: A developing note on evaluating AI product opportunities by starting with user tasks, problem frequency, and success criteria before choosing where model capabilities belong.

item.title: How I Turn AI into a Daily Work Partner
item.description: Notes on how I use AI across research, product, and writing tasks, and how I divide responsibility between human judgment and model assistance.

item.title: An AI Product Analysis Framework: From Capability Demos to Real Value
item.description: An evolving framework for examining AI products through six lenses: target users, core tasks, model capabilities, experience loops, business value, and durable advantages.

item.title: My AI Toolkit: Tools, Workflows, and Reusable Skills
item.description: A growing index of the AI tools, automated workflows, and reusable skills I create, including the problems they address, their limits, and their current status.

item.title: Eat-What
item.description: A lightweight food-and-drink picker that narrows options by occasion and flavor, supports temporary exclusions, and uses rating-weighted randomness to turn repeated comparison into an acceptable decision.

item.title: HourRead
item.description: A lightweight reading concept that matches short books to the time, mood, and context of a commute, lunch break, or evening wind-down.

item.title: Betty Xu Portfolio | An AI-Coding-Driven, Continuously Evolving Site
item.description: Turned personal positioning, project evidence, and content-maintenance needs into an evolving bilingual site, using Research → Plan → Implement, build checks, and deployment as an AI Coding loop.

item.title: AI Coding–Driven Agent Configuration Platform
item.description: Used structured specifications to organize requirements and interaction design, then worked with coding agents across frontend and backend implementation, integration testing, and launch coordination.

item.title: Insight AI
item.description: A health-information product with quick checks, guided practice, and progress review, helping users understand evidence, practice judgment, and build their own reasoning habits.

item.title: EquipFlow | Manufacturing Equipment Lifecycle Platform
item.description: Independently researched a manufacturing equipment-management problem, modeled its workflows and UML, designed the platform and database, and adapted an open-source codebase into a Vue + Spring Boot system.

item.title: Composition Analysis and Identification of Ancient Glass Artifacts
item.description: A Provincial First Prize project for Problem C of the 2022 CUMCM, analyzing weathering, composition changes, and type identification for ancient glass artifacts through statistical modeling and classification.

item.title: “Have You Subscribed?” | Online Music Willingness-to-Pay Study
item.description: Studied online music payment through user behavior and consumer psychology, validated the survey instrument, and used a random forest to turn payment drivers into platform recommendations.

item.title: MCM Forest Management | Multi-Objective Modeling of Carbon, Economy, and Water Conservation
item.description: Built layered models for forest carbon sequestration, harvesting economics, and water conservation, then applied a multi-objective management plan to larch and Mongolian oak forests in eastern Liaoning.

item.title: Lingfeng Smart Delivery | Air-Ground Collaborative Robot
item.description: Owned competitive analysis, business-model design, and financial forecasting for an air-ground delivery concept, connecting differentiation to revenue paths and funding assumptions.
